scoring_justification: The checker can recompute the Bragg-Williams order parameters from the agent's CSV using the same published interaction energies and free-energy expressions, enabling T1 recompute scoring.

hidden_assets.purpose: provide reference transition temperatures for CuMnPt6 and MnPt7
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper 'ABC6 Type Ordered Structure' (Ohshima et al., 2008)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the paper text (Tc=1241 K, Tcl=1019 K for CuMnPt6; Tc=1065 K, Tcl=941 K for MnPt7)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the experimentally measured transition temperatures reported by the authors; they serve as the hidden gold to verify that the agent's computed order parameter curves locate transitions correctly.

outputs.description: Equilibrium order parameters S1 and S3 for CuMnPt6 as functions of temperature.
Equilibrium order parameters S1 and S3 for MnPt7 as functions of temperature.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes S1 and S3 from the same Bragg-Williams free energy model and compares the agent's values within tolerance; also verifies transition temperatures within 5% of paper-reported values.
